findings.text: the §2j table's fourth row (run review-gate-covers-every-writing-run) is a field naming the first of a node's two control logs, whose mutation the node never declared — a path that resolves and exits non-zero but evidences the wrong mutation. _control_log_findings deliberately compares no wording (reckon/crew/reports.py:1053-1059), so that shape passes, and no test writes it; the plan's done-when asks that each of the four shapes be refused at write time, so the fourth is unmet by this check and is left to the promotion gate's log resolver.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 1 production call site: reckon/cli.py:4293 crew_check_manifest calls audit_manifest, which is what makes the refusal reach the worker's own turn.
item_verdicts.diff: read at ef7fd092a. The production change is 135 lines added to reckon/crew/reports.py: a NEGATIVE_CONTROL_WAIVER_FIELD constant, _terminal_exit_status, _read_control_log and _control_log_findings, plus the manifest_path parameter and one findings.extend call in audit_manifest. The test file adds 366 lines across eighteen cases (twelve through audit_manifest, six through the CLI). No other module in reckon/crew/reports.py reads negative_control_log, and audit_manifest has exactly one production caller (reckon/cli.py:4293) besides its export.
item_verdicts.done_when: §2j's write-time requirement that the negative_control_log field be validated where its writer still holds a turn is delivered and reachable: the command surface refuses each refused shape (tests/test_a_control_log_is_judged_at_write.py::test_the_command_refuses_an_empty_control_log, ::test_the_command_refuses_a_path_carrying_prose), and the refusal names the field and what it found. The status half of the same done-when landed earlier (914533ad) and is out of this run's scope. One of the four table shapes — a resolvable field naming the wrong control log — is not refused, which the run discloses in its evidence_inputs.
item_verdicts.goal: the dispatched goal was to judge a node's negative_control_log where its writer can still repair it, rather than only at promotion hours after the worker has ended. reckon/crew/reports.py:_control_log_findings now refuses, inside audit_manifest, an empty field, a value carrying anything besides a path, a mapping or list of sub-keys, a path that does not resolve, a readable log whose last non-blank line is not a bare EXIT=<code>, and a log recording EXIT=0, for a node that writes a test path and declares a control; a declaration of none, a node with no test write path, a run that has not claimed completion and a recorded negative_control_waiver reason are exempt. It is reached through reckon crew check-manifest at reckon/cli.py:4293.
item_verdicts.manifest: its commits (30a5f1834, ef7fd092a), changed_paths, tests and negative_control_log match the tree; the reviewed worktree is clean at ef7fd092a. logs/gate-head.log reads 53 passed EXIT=0 at revision 30a5f1834 and logs/gate-base.log reads 20 failed / 33 passed EXIT=1 at 1c20ca680, so the added-failure derivation reads a measured zero; logs/negative-control-removed-check.log ends EXIT=1 with the declared mutation on its first line. The manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite JSON names the two logs and their revisions, and run check-manifest over the run itself returns ok with findings []. The base scratch tree it measured in was deleted, so only its log's header attests to that path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the section grants reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_a_control_log_is_judged_at_write.py, an evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/ and a docs/figures/... directory. The two commits touch exactly the first three; the figures directory is unused. No changed path lies outside the grant.

justifications.durability: the new checks are isolated (tmp_path, the isolated_reckon_home fixture, a dedicated basetemp per arm), the negative control reddens eleven of them, and test_the_command_writes_no_state_beside_the_run_it_reads asserts the CLI leaves the home tree unchanged. Deducted because the production command's relative-path resolution (reckon/crew/reports.py:1199-1205, the node.manifest_path fallback) is covered only by a direct audit_manifest call and not by a relative negative_control_log through reckon crew check-manifest, so the CLI's end-to-end resolution for a relative value is unpinned; the fallback is unit-tested, so this is a coverage note rather than a live defect.
justifications.evidence: both arms reproduced independently here: head 53 passed EXIT=0 at ef7fd092a, a base arm reconstructed by me from 1c20ca680's own reports.py with the head test files reads 20 failed / 33 passed EXIT=1, matching the reviewed run's gate logs, and rerunning the declared mutation (removing the _control_log_findings call from audit_manifest) reddens the new file 11 failed / 13 passed EXIT=1, matching logs/negative-control-removed-check.log. The base arm is a scratch tree with measurement_module and measurement_cwd recorded, and logs/repro-empty-control-at-base.log shows the pre-change defect (findings [] at 1c20ca680). Deducted one because the reviewed manifest's base arm was run in a scratch tree that was deleted, so its reproduction rests on the log's own header rather than a re-runnable path.
justifications.fit: the change adds one cohesive helper pair (_read_control_log, _control_log_findings) and one field constant beside the existing audit, reuses reckon/crew/node.is_test_path and negative_control_is_none rather than re-derive the trigger or the none-form, and extends audit_manifest with a single manifest_path parameter that defaults to the node's own recorded path. It duplicates no existing refusal: no other site in reckon/crew/reports.py reads negative_control_log. Deducted two because the check's trigger restates the dispatcher's is_test_path heuristic at the point of judgment, so the two can drift, and the strictness of the terminal EXIT=<code> convention is baked into a regex rather than shared with the capture convention that writes it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the write-time half of §2j's done-when lands: audit_manifest now judges negative_control_log for a node whose write paths include a test file and whose declaration is not none, refuses an empty field, a path carrying prose, a mapping of sub-keys, a non-resolving path, a log with no terminal EXIT record and a log recording EXIT=0, and reaches the worker through reckon crew check-manifest (reckon/crew/reports.py:995-1126, exercised end to end by tests/test_a_control_log_is_judged_at_write.py::test_the_command_refuses_an_empty_control_log). Deducted because the §2j table's fourth row — a field naming the wrong one of a node's two control logs — is not refused at the write and no test writes it, so the done-when's 'each of the four shapes ... refused at write time' is met for three of the four.
justifications.scope_discipline: three changed paths (reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_a_control_log_is_judged_at_write.py, docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/a-control-log-is-judged-at-write.html) all lie inside the run's declared write paths; the declared figures directory is correctly left unused; both commits carry a conventional subject and a body with no AI trailer and no plan or sprint identifier; no plan state, project index or peer path is touched.
